name: Peech
summary: Peech is an AI video editor for marketers, offering automated subtitling, branding, and highlight detection to repurpose long-form content for social media.
description:
Peech is an AI video editor for marketers, offering automated subtitling, branding, and highlight detection to repurpose long-form content for social media.

The previous website did not resolve on 21 October 2026, so the card is marked closed until someone confirms a new URL.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

features: Automatic highlight detection: AI scans and extracts the best moments from your content for social media sharing.
AI branding: Applies logos, colors, and fonts consistently across all your video content.
Auto-subtitling: Generates accurate, stylized captions to boost accessibility and engagement.
Batch video repurposing: Turn webinars or podcasts into dozens of clips for different platforms in one workflow.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Log In
howToUse.description: Visit Peech AI and create an account. Log in to your personalized dashboard to start editing.

howToUse.title: Upload Your Video Content
howToUse.description: Click on 'Upload' and select your webinar, podcast, or long-form video. Peech supports popular video formats such as MP4 and MOV.

howToUse.title: Automatic Highlight Detection
howToUse.description: Let Peech’s AI analyze your video and automatically detect the most engaging highlights suitable for social sharing.

howToUse.title: Apply Branding
howToUse.description: Customize your video with your brand’s logos, colors, and fonts. Peech applies brand consistency across all output clips.

howToUse.title: Generate and Edit Subtitles
howToUse.description: Peech automatically creates subtitles for your video. Edit the captions for accuracy or style them to match your branding.

howToUse.title: Batch Repurposing
howToUse.description: Use batch features to turn one long-form video into multiple short, platform-ready clips for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Reels, and more.

howToUse.title: Preview & Export
howToUse.description: Preview all generated clips, make any final adjustments, and export them in the desired format for your preferred platforms.
